fside.contrastConvention: contrast = S(reference) - S(challenger=F_MOTOR_STACK). Interval entirely above 0 => challenger better; entirely below 0 => reference better; contains 0 => NOT_ESTABLISHED.

M0_EXPONENTIAL.note: Width reported here is the PERCENTILE width and is labelled as such - see D7, where the frozen artifact's `width` field silently reported the companion interval while verdicts used BCa.

determinism.rngConstruction: np.random.default_rng(seed) constructed ONCE per contrast; common random numbers across contrasts

F_MOTOR_STACK.note: Per-motor latents integrated by 33-node Gauss-Hermite quadrature, NOT estimated. Parameter count is independent of motor count.

M8_EMPIRICAL_KDE.fittedOn: TRAIN_ONLY (bandwidth frozen, locations from 793 training events)
M8_EMPIRICAL_KDE.inclusionReason: INCLUDED: obtainable from the frozen record with no new exploratory holdout work, and its recomputed holdout aggregate reproduces the published M8 score exactly, which makes it a third oracle.
M8_EMPIRICAL_KDE.source: FROZEN_B3_BANDWIDTH: h read from the frozen record; the KDE locations s are recomputed deterministically from the TRAINING events only. No cross-validation is re-run and no holdout data enters the fit.

fside.floorPolicy: NO_FLOOR - a non-finite log density HALTS (matches frozen B3)

m8Inclusion.reason: INCLUDED: obtainable from the frozen record with no new exploratory holdout work, and its recomputed holdout aggregate reproduces the published M8 score exactly, which makes it a third oracle.

checks.why: frozen B3 fitted params, not refitted

oracleConsistencyCheck.note: B3 stores only AGGREGATED scores - there are no per-motor arrays in the frozen record - so every per-motor array here is recomputed. That is exactly why this check is mandatory rather than optional.
oracleConsistencyCheck.toleranceJustification: Parameters are read verbatim from the frozen JSON and the cohort is rebuilt by the frozen Cohort class in the frozen event order, so every FP operation and summation order matches the recorded run: the expected residual is exactly 0.0 and 1e-12 absolute (~3e-13 relative, ~1000 ULP) is pure last-place headroom. The tolerance is not to be loosened; a residual above it is a convention error and is the finding.

resolution.canResolve: Differences whose paired per-motor contrast interval excludes 0. In practice, with 19 motors, roughly >~0.042 nats of motor-equal separation unless the per-motor difference is unusually consistent.
resolution.cannotResolve: Anything smaller. An interval crossing 0 is NOT_ESTABLISHED / INCONCLUSIVE - never 'no difference' and never 'equivalent'. Underpowered is not equivalence. Replicates were not and must not be increased after seeing a width.

scaleConvention.definition: NLPD of the observed dwell in SECONDS = -log p(y) + log scale_N[state], y = durationS / scale_N[stateN]
scaleConvention.warning: score.score_motor_stack returns NORMALISED-y NLPD with no Jacobian. The constant cancels in a CONTRAST and does not cancel in an ABSOLUTE score. Every number in this file is on the SECONDS scale.

splitProvenance.holdoutDurationStatus: already prospectively spent by B3; duration-only held-out scoring is the permitted reuse
splitProvenance.rightCensoredPolicy: EXCLUDED from the frozen cohort entirely; the F-side censoring branch is unexercised here

strongestAdversary.selectionBasis: POINT ESTIMATE, used only to name which adversary is strongest. A point estimate is never a verdict; see contrasts[<model>].verdict.

dataFlow.worldProcess: Previously recorded individual E. coli flagellar-motor stator-remodeling traces
dataFlow.inference: Training-fitted survival likelihood updates posterior mass over two predictive timescales.
dataFlow.prediction: Frozen probability density and survival curve for events from held-out motors.

claims.claim: Held-out dwell timing rejects the homogeneous memoryless duration prediction within the frozen analysis population.
claims.fence: This does not uniquely identify a molecular hidden state; heterogeneity and nonstationarity remain alternatives.

claims.claim: The training-fitted two-timescale mixture assigned higher predictive density to held-out dwell events than the memoryless baseline.
claims.fence: Predictive superiority does not prove that the latent mixture components are biological states or that the motor performs Bayesian inference.

claims.claim: Within the frozen mixture model, surviving longer without a transition increases posterior mass on the slower latent timescale.
claims.fence: This is exact inference in the declared model, illustrated with observed durations; it is not evidence that a bacterium represents this posterior.

claims.claim: Training-only stator-count-conditioned transition frequencies were evaluated on held-out motors.
claims.fence: The point estimate improved, but the motor-cluster interval crosses zero. Secondary and inconclusive; it cannot rescue a failed duration hypothesis.
